new_value: The project comprises of 7 Residential Towers (T03, T07, T08, T10, T11, T14, T15) part of overall 65 acre Mixed Use Development located on Bellary Road, Byatarayanapura, Bangalore, India and comprises of IT SEZ / Commercial Offices, Retail, Residential, Clubhouse, etc., The intent is to create a masterpiece in residential living integrated with Offices which will be a lifestyle destination in achieving “Walk to Work” concept. Along with this the endeavour is to create a fully sufficient, sustainable, self-contained gated and secure township with local retail, public/semi-public amenities, parks & open spaces, strong urban streets, utilities etc. A place which will have unique themed gardens/landscapes with unique features like putting green as mini golf course practice, tennis courts, cycling/skating track, etc. Various infrastructure facilities like roads, power, water management system, reticulated gas supply system, waste management system (solid & sewage), high-tech optical fibre connectivity are expected to be seamlessly integrated into the Mixed Use Development. The theme is to create Gated Community Neighborhood catering to the middle income & high income groups with integrated Work Place which will be path breaking or futuristic in development, reflecting L&T's values towards environment and sustainability. The development should be a destination which people would desire or yearn to belong to and should be proud to behold.

new_value: "Brigade Southfield located in the heart of Whitefield, upcoming office space development brings together the much needed balance between work and play. Compact central core frees up the periphery for bright work spaces that have the flexibility of being divided for small scale business or unified large offices. Lush landscape provides for relaxing outdoor lunches and step out from a hard day of work for a bit of basketball and other interactive activities to help take a breather. The overall composition of the architectural elements reads as one of solidity interspersed with vertical inset of glazing which open up the facade and add on to its visual impact by dramatically increasing the verticality of the building. new_value: The ICON NORTH Project is a Joint venture development with the land owners as per the terms of Joint development agreements. The Project ICON NORTH, is a residential condominium situated at Thanisandra main road, Bengaluru spreading over the land area of about 19 acres. The project consists of 12 towers & a clubhouse which has been developed in phases comprising of 3 BHK,4 BHK and few 2 BHK apartments & penthouses. Total number of apartments proposed is about 1131 and developed in phases. The project offers about 85% open space & amenities like tennis courts, swimming pool, basketball court, central park, putting green, cricket pitch with nets, outdoor gym, bird nesting areas, amphitheatre etc., The project is environmental friendly and IGBC pre-certified gold. The Project is partially complete with Towers A and B , handed over to the purchasers. For this proposal to RERA, the Phase comprising of Towers -C, D & E in Cluster-III is considered as a ongoing Project. Tower C is GF+27 Floors comprising of 108 apartments, Tower D is GF+27 Floors comprising of 108 apartments and Tower E is GF+27 Floors comprising of 106 apartments, with two common basements. The land area , covered area and open area along with facilities and ameneties mentioned herein is common for the whole Project .

new_value: Symphony Heights is a modern residential tower that redefines urban living with contemporary elegance. Rising 20 storeys tall, this thoughtfully designed tower is set amidst 2 acres of land at Byrathi, off Hennur – one of North Bangalore’s most vibrant neighborhoods. The development enjoys excellent connectivity and proximity to schools, retail hubs, educational institutions, and business parks. With just 128 spacious 3 & 3.5 BHK residences, Symphony Heights is crafted to offer privacy, tranquility, and everyday ease. Designed with only 7 apartments per core, each home is filled with natural light, uninterrupted views, and seamless circulation. Spanning from 1,795 to 1,935 sq. ft., every residence is intelligently planned with generous proportions, premium specifications, smart zoning, and minimal shared walls – ensuring comfort and complete privacy. Every home opens to expansive balconies that extend the living and dining areas, offering uninterrupted views and greater privacy. At Symphony Heights, private and community life flow in perfect harmony. While the personal moments unfold in the quiet comfort of home, the community is thoughtfully layered across three distinct zones – the ground, podium, and rooftop. Each level offers a unique rhythm: from lively club facilities and interactive plazas to serene green pockets and wellness-inspired rooftop leisure spaces. Adding to the uniqueness is the elevated landscaped walkway – shielding parking areas below while connecting key amenities above, creating a refreshing space for leisure walks and casual connections with neighbors. Sustainability is at the heart of Symphony Heights. Green living is seamlessly integrated through water and energy conservation initiatives, efficient waste management systems, and eco-conscious planning, ensuring a lifestyle that is as responsible as it is elevated.

new_value: Disha Pursuit of the Elements Phase 1, located at Gunjur takes inspiration from the five elements of nature, namely: space, fire, air, water, and earth. Their core elemental attributes have been captured in every aspect of the homes and amenities here. With 783 homes in the four towers and 60 exquisite row houses, Disha Pursuit of the Elements also houses over 80 outdoor and indoor amenities. Its plush clubhouse comes with a rooftop heated pool and a waterpark for the children, apart from music and dance studios, tuition rooms, a medical care facility, banquet halls, a fine dining space, yoga deck, a super mart, commercial spaces, indoor courts, and more. This twenty-acre project leaves nothing for the asking. While the expansive business centre café and the various outdoor Wi-Fi zones take care of the work-from-home needs, the senior members have their own lounge spaces, reading rooms, a library and other exclusive unwinding spaces. For the children there are multiple play areas, open grounds, a skating rink, cycling tracks, a picnic and hammock zone, interactive water bodies, outdoor games courts, everything that will keep them coming back for more.
